description_en: Queries the list of specifications supported by different types of elastic plans for a cluster
description_zh: 查询集群的不同类型弹性计划支持的规格列表
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-elastic-plan-specifications --type EXECUTOR --db-cluster-id amv-wz9509beptiz0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeElasticPlanSpecifications

parameters.help_en:
The type of the elastic plan. Valid values:

EXECUTOR: Interactive resource group, which is the compute resource type.
WORKER: storage acceleration service (EIU)
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划类型。 取值说明：

EXECUTOR：Interactive资源组，即计算资源类型。
WORKER：存储加速服务（EIU）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

To query the specifications supported by the elastic plan of an Interactive resource group (compute resource type), you must specify the resource group name. To query the specifications supported by the elastic plan of the storage acceleration service (EIU), you do not need to specify the resource group name.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html operation to query the resource group name of a specific cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。

查询Interactive资源组的弹性计划（即计算资源类型的弹性计划）支持的规格时，必须指定资源组名称。查询存储加速服务（EIU）的弹性计划支持的规格时，无需指定资源组名称。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html接口可以查看指定集群的资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
